angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 992,764 km at 80.34 pc = 0.17 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 12.4470 +/- 0.0219 mas (same row, RUWE 1.11): 80.34 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.427 +/- 0.043 solar radii from Naponiello et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-5817 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...701A..79N/abstract): 992,764 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.97 +/- 0.072 solar masses from Naponiello et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-5817 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...701A..79N/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5770 +/- 50 K from Naponiello et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-5817 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...701A..79N/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Naponiello et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-5817 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...701A..79N/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-5817.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.116, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-5817 (pscomppars): spectral type G2 IV-V, from Naponiello et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...701A..79N/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-5817 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.24 dex, from Naponiello et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...701A..79N/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-5817 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.31175, from Naponiello et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...701A..79N/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-5817 (pscomppars): age 9.7 Gyr, from Naponiello et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...701A..79N/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-5817 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 1.2 km/s, from Naponiello et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...701A..79N/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
